versions.changelog:
- Added full set of reference files for personas, workflows, templates, and examples to the repository.
- Introduced `.gitignore`, LICENSE, and README.md for improved project structure and compliance.
- Removed outdated `skill-card.md` in favor of new, modular documentation.
- No changes to the core process or behavior of the skill itself.

Initial release of the product-review-panel skill:

- Launches a structured, multi-expert panel to review Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and deliver a clear verdict (GO / NO-GO / CONDITIONAL GO), with dissenting opinions always preserved.
- Dynamically adapts expert roster based on user conversation language (Chinese or English) and PRD classification.
- Enforces a rigorous review flow: intake interrogation, expert opinions, pointed debate, authoritative verdict by "The Closer," and explicit inclusion of dissent.
- Applies strict behavioral guardrails: no numeric scoring, no personal attacks, mandatory disclaimer, one verdict per run.
- Accepts flexible PRD input formats (uploaded files, pasted text, document links).
- Not for brainstorming, technical architecture, or non-product questions—use other skills for those cases.
